title: Abuja's Veltrum Technologies lists three products, from an AI workspace to electricity purchases

claims.text: Veltrum Technologies says it builds secure software, AI systems and digital infrastructure for organisations across Africa.
The company is based in Abuja, Nigeria, and says it works across Africa.
Its website lists three products: Afro AI, Accessum and GetElectric.
claims.label: Products listed

claims.text: Afro AI is described as a document-grounded workspace for conversation, learning and organisational knowledge.
Accessum is described as guest and security management designed for the operating realities of gated communities.
GetElectric is described as a direct electricity purchase experience shaped for quick, essential everyday transactions.
Veltrum says its approach is to define constraints, ownership and failure modes before implementation begins.
The site names seven team members, five of them as co-founders.
